candidates.tagline: Jaguar's £130K 'Copy Nothing' rebrand delivers a car critics called 'a hearse'
candidates.story: Jaguar unveiled the $130,500 Type 01 electric grand tourer at a New York event in October 2026, completing its controversial 'Copy Nothing' rebrand — only for critics to call it 'an unmitigated catastrophe that looks like a hearse.'
candidates.why_funny: A luxury car brand spent two years on a rebrand that showed no cars, then revealed a $130K electric car that looks like a hearse.
candidates.alt: A silver Jaguar Type 01 electric grand tourer, long and low-slung with narrow aggressive LED headlights at the front

candidates.tagline: Amazon removed Kindle's page-turn buttons. Now they sell them back for $35.
candidates.story: Amazon discontinued physical page-turn buttons on all Kindles in 2024, then in October 2026 launched the $34.99 Kindle Click Bluetooth remote and an $80 case-with-buttons — 72% of users in a poll said the buttons should just be built in.
candidates.why_funny: The company that spent a decade removing beloved buttons now charges $35 extra to restore the feature they took away.
candidates.alt: The Kindle Click, a small rounded white Bluetooth remote with two page-turn buttons and a wrist lanyard, shown next to a Kindle e-reader
